about: Phase 5a: for every program still to collect (cited by a wanted or partly Abstract table, not licensed), the files to download from its publisher. Hand-kept; checked by server/lib/downloads.js against sources.json; sizes measured by server/seed/size-downloads.js into download-sizes.json. Entries: { url }, { url with {year} or {yy}, years }, { list: folder/ } (every file in it, filtered by match) { list: page, page: true, match } (the files a page links to; `follow` opens the pages it links to, one level down) or { catalog: data.json, title } (the downloads of a DCAT catalog's datasets whose title matches). Take what the Abstract's tables need, at the finest frequency published, and skip copies (BLS's .data.0.Current files repeat the recent years of AllData).
